name: Backstabbing
overview: Scripture reveals backstabbing as a grievous betrayal, exemplified by a trusted friend who turns against another, as seen in Psalms 41:9 and Psalms 55:12 where the pain comes not from enemies but from close companions. Proverbs warns that such deceitful behavior, including false witnessing and whispering to divide friends, brings strife and is likened to weapons that harm deeply (Proverbs 16:28; 25:18). The Bible also cautions believers to avoid partaking in the fellowship of those with evil intentions, highlighting the spiritual danger in associating with those who betray trust (Proverbs 23:6). Ultimately, these verses underscore that backstabbing is a serious offense against both God and neighbor, deserving of just consequences (Proverbs 19:5).
